sections.title: Deterministic density survey & area selection
sections.context: FOLIO's Area-of-Law tree has 174 direct children. A deterministic folio-python survey (scripts/demos/regulatory_density_survey.py) ranked candidate regulatory areas by three signals: branch density (recursive descendants), definition coverage, and a 10-leaf exact-hit feasibility check. The exact-hit count is the hard gate — an area that cannot field 10 precise, unique FOLIO leaf labels is DROPPED rather than forced to 'best-available' matches. SELECTED (all 10/10 exact leaves, 100% definition coverage): Environmental Compliance (branch density 12 — FOLIO's densest regulatory branch), Securiti…

sections.title: Documented exclusions — the probe gate working
sections.context: Two plausible candidates were probed and DROPPED for thin FOLIO leaf coverage — evidence the gate is real, not decorative: Tax & Revenue — 5/10 exact leaves. FOLIO's tax branch is leaf-thin: only Tax Law, Tax Credits Law, Estates/Gifts/Trusts, Non-Profit/Tax-Exempt, and ESOP resolve precisely. Income/Property/Sales/International/Corporate Tax have no precise FOLIO node (they fuzzy-match to broad parents). Healthcare / health-privacy — 3/10 exact leaves, branch density 0. Health Law, Food and Drug Law, and Public Health & Welfare Law are leaf-terminal; Medicare/Medicaid/Pharmaceutical/Mental-H…

sections.title: Exemplar — Environmental Compliance (STRONG)
sections.context: Persona: environmental / EHS / natural-resources counsel and ESG leads. Ten leaves span air & water quality, contamination & cleanup, chemicals & resources, water & wildlife, and ESG/impact review — tracking how an environmental lawyer actually carves the domain (Clean Air/Water Act, CERCLA/RCRA, TSCA, wetlands/minerals, ESG). Densest, cleanest all-Area-of-Law taxonomy in the batch; zero overlap with existing cards. Critique fix applied: Chemical Safety Law was moved out of a mis-named 'Corporate Sustainability' branch (it is a toxics/contamination area, not governance); ESG is now paired wit…

sections.title: Exemplar — Energy & Utilities (revised WEAK→ADEQUATE)
sections.context: Persona: energy regulatory / utilities / project-development counsel (FERC, renewables, nuclear). Real and new to the portfolio. FOLIO's pure Energy-Law branch is thin (6 non-circular AoL leaves), so the exemplar supplements with energy-SPECIFIC FOLIO concepts from adjacent branches. Critique fixes applied: (1) removed the circular leaf 'Renewable Energy Law' — it is the FOLIO PARENT of Solar/Wind/Hydro, which are themselves leaves; listing a parent beside its own children is a taxonomy error the hardened gate now blocks. (2) Dropped the engineering-jargon 'Baseload Power' branch and regroupe…

sections.title: Exemplar — Securities Enforcement (revised for distinctiveness)
sections.context: Persona: SEC/FINRA regulatory & enforcement counsel; adviser/broker-dealer compliance. FOLIO concentrates securities concepts inside the branch that Banking & Finance and Corporate M&A already draw from, so the first draft overlapped those cards on 7 of 10 leaves (4 with banking-finance) — reading as a near-duplicate on the carousel. Critique fix applied: reframed from deal-work to enforcement/regulation and retitled the card 'Securities Enforcement'. Leaf overlap with banking-finance cut from 4 to 0; the card now leads with Investment Advisor Law, Exchanges Law, Commodities Law, Regulatory E…
sections.output_sample: Investment Advisor Law · Exchanges Law · Commodities Law · Insider Trading · Securities Fraud · Regulatory Enforcement · Financial Reporting Law · Security Offerings and Capital Markets Law · Business and Financial Crimes Law · Anti-Corruption Law

sections.title: Exemplar — Data Privacy & Cybersecurity (revised WEAK→STRONG)
sections.context: Persona: privacy & cybersecurity counsel / CPO / DPO (GDPR/CCPA compliance, breach response, surveillance/government access). Fastest-growing, highest-demand area in the batch; zero overlap with any v1.0 card — the clearest audience expansion. Critique fixes applied: dropped three defective leaves — Information Security Law (was BOTH the declared root branch AND a leaf: circular + near-duplicate of Cybersecurity Law), Right to Privacy (a Civil Right, cross-taxonomy and duplicative of Privacy Law), and Records Management (a Business-of-Law operations concept). Replaced with Consumer Protection…

sections.title: Quality gates — 100% hit rate + anti-circularity + zero-cost demos
sections.context: All 40 leaves pass scripts/demos/validate_exemplar_hits.py: exact unique get_by_label, top search_by_label at score 100, and no leaf is an ancestor of a co-leaf. The full web test suite covers all 14 demo areas across 6 harnesses (roundtrip, no-network, richness, excluded-branches, smoke, manifest). Demo mode makes zero runtime network calls (deterministic cached payloads).
